originalTitle: Will a new solid-state battery with an energy density exceeding 400 Wh/kg be commercially released by the end of 2024?
title: 超过 400 Wh/kg 的固态电池能否在 2024 年商业发布？
Would a solid-state battery above 400 Wh/kg be commercially released in 2024?
rules: 原规则要求超过能量密度门槛，并能商业购买或订购；平台已判定 No。
The rule requires exceeding the energy-density threshold and commercial purchase or ordering; the platform resolved No.
interpretation: 单个实验样品达到数值，不自动满足商业可购条件；平台结算也不能替代所有电池产品的技术审查。
A laboratory sample does not automatically establish commercial availability. Settlement is not a technical review of every battery product.

summary: 这是已判 No 的历史商业发布题。它同时要求比能量超过 400 Wh/kg 和原窗口内可商业购买或订购。
A resolved-No historical release contract required both over 400 Wh/kg and commercial availability within its window.
checklist: 查当时商品的测试条件与电芯质量口径。
Check contemporaneous test conditions and cell-mass basis.
查截止前真实商业购买／订购的证据。
Check actual commercial purchase or ordering before the deadline.
把后来的 VTT 报告作为技术后续阅读，不回填成旧窗口的 Yes。
Treat the later VTT report as subsequent context, not a retroactive Yes.

stage: 实验指标 → 可购买产品 → 截止内交付
Lab metric → purchasable product → timely delivery
impact: 测试和合作公告解释技术后续发展，但这两份历史合同在更早窗口已结束。后来超过某个实验指标，不能替代原截止前商业可购或交付的证据。
Tests and partnerships explain subsequent development, but these historical contracts ended earlier. A later laboratory metric cannot establish timely availability or delivery.
gap: 对已经结算的市场，保留当时价格和结果；把后续企业发展单独阅读，不回填历史信息集。
Keep historical prices and resolutions, with later corporate progress outside the original information window.

title: 400 Wh/kg 与“商业可购”，需要两套证据
400 Wh/kg and commercial availability require different evidence
principle: 比能量是放电得到的 Wh 除以质量 kg；体积能量密度则用 Wh/L。电芯、电池包与整车层级不能混用。放电倍率、温度和电压窗口也会影响测得能量。

Specific energy divides discharged Wh by mass in kg; volumetric energy density uses Wh/L. Cell, pack and vehicle measures cannot be interchanged. Rate, temperature and voltage window affect measured discharge energy.
example: VTT 的 DL6 数据提供了单电芯、低倍率下的测量实例。对较早截止的商业发布市场，还要另核对当时能否订购或收货，以及商品是否为同一电芯；后来的实验结果不能改写较早的结算记录。

VTT’s DL6 report illustrates single-cell low-rate measurement. An earlier commercial-release contract additionally needs contemporaneous ordering or delivery evidence for that product. Later measurements do not rewrite the earlier market resolution.
